title: everyday surfacing and direct edits: a vase, a cable, a thickened arch, moved, deleted and replaced faces, a thickened face, a drafted extrude

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a vase: a fit spline through (10, 0), (14, 10), (9, 25), (11, 35) closed by lines to the axis, revolved, shelled 1.2 open at its top

cases.name: c002
cases.description: a cable: a circle (radius 1.5) swept along a fit spline through (0, 0, 0), (15, 8, 4), (30, 0, 10), (45, -6, 6)

cases.name: c003
cases.description: an arched sheet lofted between an arc at y = 0 and one at y = 30 (both 40 across, rising 8), thickened 2

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a 30 × 20 × 10 block lengthened 8 by moving its end face, then its top edges filleted 2

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a 30 × 20 × 10 block with its top front edge filleted 4, the fillet then deleted

cases.name: c006
cases.description: a 30 × 20 × 10 block with a 10 × 10 boss 5 tall on its top, the block's top replaced by a plane 3 above it

cases.name: c007
cases.description: a 30 × 20 × 10 block with its front face thickened 3 out and added to it

cases.name: c008
cases.description: a circle (radius 12) extruded 15 with a 5° draft inwards, its top edge filleted 2 and a hole (radius 4) through it
